detail.title: 16CH Penta-brid 4K Value/5MP 2U 8HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR5816S-4KL-I3 16CH Penta-brid 4K Value/5MP 2U 8HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • 16-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 4K@15fps/5MP@25fps Encoding Capability • Max. 32-ch IP Video Input (Up to 12MP) • AI Functions: 2-ch QuickPick 2.0, 2-ch FR, 8-ch Perimeter Protection, 1-ch EPTZ, 1-ch Privacy Protection, 16-ch SMD, 16-ch AI Coding • 8 Bays. Up to 16TB for Each HDD Storage Capacity Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Mode: 8 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels(up to 12 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 20,000 images.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

AI Video Quality Analytics.AI Video Quality Analytics by Recorder: 16 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, color cast, defocus, overexposure, contrast levels, black and white

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 32 channels of IPC access 16 IP channels by default + 16 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) Incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 128 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, EPTZ, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, SMD, Perimeter Protection, QuickPick 2.0 and Privacy Protection cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Encode Enhancement disabled： Main stream: the 1st, 9th channel 4K@(1 fps–15 fps), others 4K@(1 fps–7 fps); the 1st, 9th channel 6 MP@(1 fps–20 fps), others 6 MP@(1 fps–10 fps); the 1st, 9th channel 5 MP@(1 fps–25 fps), others 5 MP@(1 fps–12 fps); the 1st, 9th channel 4K-N/4 MP/3 MP@(1 fps–25/30 fps), others 4K-N/4 MP/3 MP@(1 fps–15 fps); 4K@(1 fps–8 fps); 5 MP@(1 fps-15 fps);4M-N/1080p/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 960H@(1 fps–15 fps); D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Encode Enhancement enabled： Main stream: the 1st, 5th, 9th, 13th channel 4K@(1 fps–15 fps), others 4K@(1 fps–7 fps); the 1st, 5th, 9th, 13th channel 6 MP@(1 fps–20 fps), others 6 MP@(1 fps–10 fps); the 1st, 5th, 9th, 13th channel 5 MP@(1 fps–25 fps), others 5 MP@(1 fps–12 fps); the 1st, 5th, 9th, 13th channel 4K-N/4 MP/3 MP@(1 fps–25/30 fps), others 4K-N/4 MP/3 MP@(1 fps–15 fps); 4K/6 MP@(1 fps–10 fps);5 MP@(1 fps-15 fps); 4M-N/1080p/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 960H@(1 fps–15 fps); D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) *When Encode Enhancement is enabled, EPTZ, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, Perimeter Protection, QuickPick 2.0 and Privacy Protection cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Video Output: 2 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 CVBS HDMI1: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA/HDMI2: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Heterogeneous video sources output for HDMI 2 is configurable.
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25/36
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic; Sony; Hanwha; Axis; Arecont; ONVIF

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 24.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; alarm; motion detection; intelligent; POS
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; local alarm; alarm box; HDCVI alarm; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); local alarm output; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Disk Interface: 8 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
Ports.USB: 4 (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports)

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
